title: What to Eat in Georgia: 15 Dishes
excerpt: Khinkali, three kinds of khachapuri, badrijani, pkhali and churchkhela: 15 Georgian dishes worth trying, how to eat them and what to order if you skip meat.
content:
Georgian food rests on a few things done very well: bread with cheese, dumplings, meat over fire and vegetables pounded with walnuts, garlic and fresh herbs. If you try only five dishes, make them khinkali, imeruli khachapuri, badrijani, pkhali and mtsvadi. Below are 15 dishes worth ordering, how to eat the tricky ones and what to choose if you skip meat.

Bread and dumplings

1. Khinkali

Twisted parcels of thin dough with spiced minced meat and a mouthful of hot broth inside. They come from the mountain valleys along the Georgian Military Road, and Pasanauri, 90 km north of Tbilisi, is the classic lunch stop for them.

How to eat them: with your hands. Hold the knot on top, bite a small hole in the side, drink the broth, then eat the rest and leave the knot on the plate.

2. Khachapuri in three regional styles

  • Imeruli: round and flat, with the cheese baked inside.
  • Megruli: the same, with a second layer of cheese melted on top.
  • Adjaruli: a boat of bread with cheese, an egg yolk and butter, "the one everyone photographs".

Where to try them

A supra for four people in a Tbilisi restaurant costs about 120 GEL with wine. The Dezerter Bazaar, a 15-minute walk from the old town, sells churchkhela and cheese from every region; read our guide to the sulphur baths for the walk back.

title: Tbilisi Sulphur Baths: Which One to Choose
excerpt: The sulphur baths of Abanotubani: prices, private rooms and the scrub, and which bath to choose.
content:
The sulphur baths of Abanotubani sit at the foot of Narikala fortress, where hot springs at 38 to 40 degrees have drawn bathers for centuries. A private room for two costs from 80 GEL an hour, and the public pools are cheaper.

Here is the revised version of the guide, with the opening hours checked again.

Which bath to choose

Chreli Abano, with its blue mosaic front, is the one in every photograph. Gulo's Thermal Spa and the Royal Bath are quieter, and all of them rent towels and sell a scrub with a kisi mitt for about 30 GEL.
